description: Figures for a whole local authority (a council area such as Leeds, Manchester or Hackney), added up over the postcode districts that sit mostly inside it: median sold price over all their sales and its 12-month change, population, household income, deprivation, and live sale and rent listings. The result says how many districts it covers. Takes a local authority name. For one postcode district, postcode or town use get_area_overview. England & Wales only. It describes the authority as it is and does not forecast prices.

authority.description: A local authority (council area) name, e.g. "Leeds", "Manchester", "Hackney"
